title: Heat shock protein 27 regulates myogenic and self-renewal potential of bovine satellite cells under heat stress.
authors: Kim, Won Seob; Daddam, Jayasimha R; Keng, Boon Hong; Kim, Jaehwan; Kim, Jongkyoo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究热应激下牛卫星细胞中HSP27与Myf5的蛋白-蛋白结合及肌源调控，虽含蛋白-蛋白对接，但核心非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: While satellite cells play a key role in the hypertrophy, repair, and regeneration of skeletal muscles, their response to heat exposure remains poorly understood, particularly in beef cattle. This study aimed to investigate the changes in the transcriptome, proteome, and proliferation capability of bovine satellite cells in response to different levels of heat stress (HS) and exposure times. Satellite cells were isolated from 3-mo-old Holstein bulls (body weight: 77.10 +/- 2.02 kg) and subjected to incubation under various temperature conditions: 1) control (38  degrees C; CON), 2) moderate (39.5  degrees C; MHS), and extreme (41  degrees C; EHS) for different durations ranging from 0 to 48 h. Following 3 h of exposure to extreme heat (EHS), satellite cells exhibited significantly increased gene expression and protein abundance of heat shock proteins (HSPs; HSP70, HSP90, HSP20) and paired box gene 7 (Pax7; P < 0.05). HSP27 expression peaked at 3 h of EHS and remained elevated until 24 h of exposure (P < 0.05). In contrast, the expression of myogenic factor 5 (Myf5) and paired box gene 3 (Pax3) was decreased by EHS compared to the control at 3 h of exposure (P < 0.05). Notably, the introduction of HSP27 small interference RNA (siRNA) transfection restored Myf5 expression to control levels, suggesting an association between HSP27 and Myf5 in regulating the self-renewal properties of satellite cells upon heat exposure. Immunoprecipitation experiments further confirmed the direct binding of HSP27 to Myf5, supporting its role as a molecular chaperone for Myf5. Protein-protein docking algorithms predicted a high probability of HSP27-Myf5 interaction as well. These findings indicate that extreme heat exposure intrinsically promotes the accumulation of HSPs and modulates the early myogenic regulatory factors in satellite cells. Moreover, HSP27 acts as a molecular chaperone by binding to Myf5, thereby regulating the division or differentiation of satellite cells in response to HS. The results of this study provide a better understanding of muscle physiology in heat-stressed cells, while unraveling the intricate molecular mechanisms that underlie the HS response in satellite cells.
abstract_zh: 虽然卫星细胞在骨骼肌的肥大、修复和再生中发挥关键作用，但其对热暴露的反应仍知之甚少，尤其是在肉牛中。本研究旨在探讨牛卫星细胞在不同程度热应激（HS）和暴露时间下转录组、蛋白质组及增殖能力的变化。卫星细胞分离自3月龄荷斯坦公牛（体重：77.10 +/- 2.02 kg），并在不同温度条件下孵育：1）对照（38 摄氏度；CON），2）中度（39.5 摄氏度；MHS），和极端（41 摄氏度；EHS），持续时间从0到48小时不等。在极端热（EHS）暴露3小时后，卫星细胞表现出热休克蛋白（HSPs；HSP70、HSP90、HSP20）和配对盒基因7（Pax7）的基因表达和蛋白质丰度显著增加（P < 0.05）。HSP27表达在EHS 3小时时达到峰值，并持续升高至暴露24小时（P < 0.05）。相比之下，与对照相比，EHS在暴露3小时时降低了生肌因子5（Myf5）和配对盒基因3（Pax3）的表达（P < 0.05）。值得注意的是，引入HSP27小干扰RNA（siRNA）转染将Myf5表达恢复至对照水平，表明HSP27与Myf5在调节卫星细胞热暴露后自我更新特性方面存在关联。免疫沉淀实验进一步证实了HSP27与Myf5的直接结合，支持其作为Myf5分子伴侣的作用。蛋白质-蛋白质对接算法也预测了HSP27-Myf5相互作用的高概率。这些发现表明，极端热暴露内在促进HSPs的积累，并调节卫星细胞中的早期生肌调节因子。此外，HSP27通过结合Myf5作为分子伴侣，从而调节卫星细胞对HS的响应中的分裂或分化。本研究结果提供了对热应激细胞中肌肉生理学的更好理解，同时揭示了卫星细胞中HS反应背后的复杂分子机制。
